fields.Name: Collaboration Space Subtree
fields.Description: Returns all space IDs in the subtree reachable by the acting user, starting from PrimaryScopeRecordID. A space is in the subtree while its status allows agent retrieval (stage 1: statuses replace post-close access).
fields.SQL:
WITH RootSpace AS (
    SELECT sc.SpaceID
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceChat] sc
    WHERE (sc.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR sc.ConversationID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))
      AND LEN(TRIM({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }})) = 36
    UNION
    SELECT s.ID AS SpaceID
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s
    WHERE s.ID = TRY_CAST({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }} AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
      AND LEN(TRIM({{ PrimaryScopeRecordID | sqlString }})) = 36
),
AncestorCheck AS (
    SELECT s.ID, s.ParentID, s.AgentRetrieval, 0 AS Steps
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s
    INNER JOIN RootSpace r ON s.ID = r.SpaceID

    UNION ALL

    SELECT a.ID, a.ParentID, a.AgentRetrieval, ac.Steps + 1
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] a
    INNER JOIN AncestorCheck ac ON a.ID = ac.ParentID
    WHERE ac.Steps < 32
),
Subtree AS (
    SELECT s.ID AS SpaceID, 0 AS Steps
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s
    INNER JOIN RootSpace r ON s.ID = r.SpaceID
    INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationSpaceStatuses]() sst ON sst.SpaceID = s.ID
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AncestorCheck WHERE AgentRetrieval = 'ExcludedEntirely')
      AND sst.AgentRetrieval = 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT c.ID AS SpaceID, p.Steps + 1
    FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] c
    INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationSpaceStatuses]() cst ON cst.SpaceID = c.ID
    INNER JOIN Subtree p ON c.ParentID = p.SpaceID
    WHERE c.AgentRetrieval NOT IN ('ExcludedEntirely', 'ExcludedFromParentScope')
      AND p.Steps < 32
      AND cst.AgentRetrieval = 1
)
SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), s.SpaceID) AS SpaceID
FROM Subtree s
INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]({{ UserID | sqlString }}) a ON a.SpaceID = s.SpaceID
